author: D00ZiE
body:
I have made this topic before on the old forums and it was very well received yet no change was made. So seeing as there are many updates coming and many things are changing, I would like to purpose that we come up with new names for the ranks. Our current names are incredibly bland and basic. We have an extremely creative community that can no doubt come up with some better names. 

Some examples :3


Post some of your suggestions below! :D
